feeds.title: Laura Purdie Salas Blog
feeds.description: Children's picture book author Laura Purdie Salas writes mostly nonfiction, poetry, and rhyming books. Salas is a visiting author, a speaker, and the creator of Writer in Progress.

feeds.title: Poetry4kids
feeds.description: Poetry4kids.com is the funny poetry playground of children's author Kenn Nesbitt. Here you will find lots of funny poems for kids, classic children's poems, games, poetry lessons and activities, plus a rhyming dictionary, videos, author visit information, and lots more.

feeds.title: Live Your Poem
feeds.description: This blog is written by Irene Latham, an American author who writes imaginative books for kids.

feeds.title: The Poetry Zone
feeds.description: The Poetry Zone is a site for publishing children's work, for teachers and poets. This blog is managed by Roger Stevens, a children's poet and editor, and has written 40 children's books.

feeds.title: The Miss Rumphius Effect
feeds.description: This blog is of a teacher educator discussing poetry, children's literature and issues related to teaching children and their future teachers.

feeds.title: Little Learning Corner » Children's Poetry
feeds.description: The goal of the blog is to help kindergarten teachers and parents keep the learning fun with seasonal content, including independent work stations and poetry activities.

feeds.title: Poetry Box
feeds.description: The blog is a New Zealand poetry page for children brought to you by Paula Green, who has published 11 books based on poetry.

feeds.title: Liz Garton Scanlon
feeds.description: Liz Garton Scanlon is the author of numerous beloved books for young people, including the highly-acclaimed, Caldecott-honored picture book All the World and many more. Ms. Scanlon serves on the faculty of the Vermont College of Fine Arts, and is a frequent and popular presenter at schools, libraries and conferences.

feeds.title: my juicy little universe
feeds.description: This blog is written by Heidi Mordhorst, who is a teacher, author of books like ''Squeeze', 'Pumpkin butterfly', etc. and a blogger at the crossroads of public school & poetry.

feeds.title: Read Write Believe
feeds.description: This blog is written by Sara Holmes, the author of The Wolf Hour and Operation Yes (Arthur A. Levine Books/Scholastic), and Letters From Rapunzel (HarperCollins).

feeds.title: & Poem of the Day Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Australian Children's Poetry website. This site is dedicated to showcasing contemporary Australian children's poets and their work.

feeds.title: Poetry Roundabout
feeds.description: Poetry Roundabout is a blog celebrating children's poetry and poets from all over the world. It will be whirling with the poems, opinions, jokes, and posts of as many children's poets as possible each year.

feeds.title: Radio, Rhythm & Rhyme
feeds.description: Tying together poetry, parenting, and advertising in a neat little package. This blog features the writings and ramblings of children's writer and voiceover talent Matt Forrest Esenwine.

feeds.title: Children's Author David L. Harrison's Blog
feeds.description: David Harrison is a children's book author - 80 published books, includes poetry, picture books, non-fiction. His work has been translated into twelve languages, anthologized more than one hundred eighty-five times, and appeared in over eighty magazines and professional journals.

feeds.title: Beyond Literacy Link
feeds.description: A dedicated space brought to you by Carol Varsalona to ponder, reflect, and converse about life, literacy, and learning.

feeds.title: Poetrepository
feeds.description: This blog is written by Mary Lee Hahn, a 5th grade teacher, reader, blogger, poet-in-training. She is the author of Reconsidering Read-Aloud (Stenhouse) and has poems in various publications.

feeds.title: Reflections on the Teche
feeds.description: This space is where I capture my thoughts, share my insights, and make connections with the world.

feeds.title: Troika Books Blog
feeds.description: Troika Books is a small, UK-based, independent children's book publisher with big ambitions which publishes picture books, fiction and poetry for children of all ages from early years to young adult.

feeds.title: Children's Poetry Summit
feeds.description: The Children's Poetry Summit is a UK network of individuals and organisations actively interested in poetry for children. It provides a regular forum for discussion, information exchange, sharing of ideas and good practice, and a pressure group which campaigns for children's poetry.

feeds.title: Salt City Verse
feeds.description: This blog is written by Janice Scully who writes for young people. Here you will find posts about her favorite poets and poems.

feeds.title: Imagine the Possibilities
feeds.description: This blog is written by Rose Cappelli, who is a lover of literacy with a passion for children's books, especially picture books. Recently, she has turned her attention to writing her own children's books.

feeds.title: Science Rhymes Blog
feeds.description: Creating rhyming verse about primary science topics as a teacher/student resource. Facts and fun packed in poems for children.

feeds.title: Poetry for Children
feeds.description: Poetry for Children is a wonderful blog, created by Professor Sylvia Vardell, about everything that's going on in the world of children's poetry, including information new book releases, awards, and lots, lots more.

feeds.title: No Water River
feeds.description: Renee LaTulippe has co-authored nine award-winning early readers and blogs on children's poetry at NoWaterRiver.com. The initial purpose of No Water River was to provide a place for the author to practice the craft of children's poetry, appreciate gorgeous picture books, and have some fun along the way.

feeds.title: Liz Brownlee poet
feeds.description: Hello! I am Liz Brownlee, a British poet and author. I write children's poetry. This blog has poems and information and poetry news.

feeds.title: Stone Soup » Children's Poems
feeds.description: Stone Soup is the literary magazine and website written and illustrated by kids through age 13. Now in its 47th year, Stone Soup has been inspiring children to read, write and create their own artworks for publication in our magazine since 1973.

feeds.title: Today's Little Ditty
feeds.description: This blog is brought to you by Michelle Barnes who writes children's poetry, picture books, greeting card copy and brings out the natural musicality and rhythm of words within the sphere of her imagination.

feeds.title: Kathryn Apel Blog
feeds.description: Kathryn Apel is a children's author and part-time literacy coordinator. She is the author of Fencing with Fear and she has had poetry and short stories published in children's magazines in Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. Kathryn specializes in poetry workshops for kids and adults - and staff professional development sessions across grades and curriculum area. She shares her poetry on her blog.

feeds.title: Laura Shovan
feeds.description: Laura Shovan is the author of the award-winning middle grade novel, The Last Fifth Grade of Emerson Elementary. Her second book, Takedown, is a Junior Library Guild and PJ Our Way selection. Her latest book is A Place at the Table, co-written with Saadia Faruqi. Laura is a poet-in-the-schools Maryland.

feeds.title: Random Noodling
feeds.description: Random Noodling is a collection of Haiku, cherita, tanka and other small form poetry from Diane Mayr.

feeds.title: Wondering and Wandering
feeds.description: This blog is written by Christie Wyman, a Kindergarten teacher and Grade Leader in Massachusetts, as well as a Lead Ambassador for Wonderopolis.org and poet.

feeds.title: Elizabeth Steinglass
feeds.description: Elizabeth Steinglass is a poet for kids and their grown-ups, a nature lover, a book lover and a mom.

feeds.title: Doing The Work That Matters
feeds.description: Author Dani Burtsfield plans for this blog will center around all aspects of literacy instruction, as she is passionate about igniting a love for all things reading & writing in her students.

feeds.title: Wild Rose Reader
feeds.description: This blog is written by Elaine Magliaro, who has worked as an elementary school teacher for more than three decades and as a school librarian for three years. She has taught children's literature course at Boston University and now writes poetry for children.

feeds.title: The Poem Farm
feeds.description: The Poem Farm is a poem garden and forest of mini lessons for home and classroom. Written by Amy Ludwig VanDerwater, this blog is a searchable collection of over 500 poems and lessons about writing poetry. Posts often include audio, book recommendations, and ideas for your writing.

feeds.title: GottaBook
feeds.description: GottaBook is a collection of thoughts, opinions, and ramblings about (broadly) children's literature from author's perspectives as a writer, parent, and volunteer elementary school librarian. Posts on Fibs, Oddaptations and poetry galore, all are listed in the blog.
